{{Short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Per Osland''' is a Norwegian physicist specializing in theoretical [[particle physics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://folk.uib.no/nfypo/|title=Theoretical particle physics|publisher=University of Bergen|access-date=2022-01-06|archive-date=2021-09-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210929015053/https://folk.uib.no/nfypo/|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is a [[professor emeritus]] at the [[University of Bergen]].<ref name=cv/> In the Spring of 2011, Osland was a Fellow at the [[Swedish Collegium for Advanced Study]] in [[Uppsala]], [[Sweden]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Former Fellows SCAS |url=https://www.swedishcollegium.se/fellows/former-fellows/all-former-fellows }}</ref>

==Education and career==
Osland earned a degree in physics from the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] in 1968, and completed a Ph.D. at the [[University of Trondheim]] in 1975. He became a professor at the University of Bergen in 1987.<ref name=cv/>

==Book==
He is the coauthor with [[Roy J. Glauber]] of the book ''Asymptotic Diffraction Theory and Nuclear Scattering'' (Cambridge University Press, 2019).

==Recognition==
Osland was elected to the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]] in 1989. He was president of the [[Norwegian Physical Society]] from 2010 to 2013.<ref name=cv>{{cite web|url=https://folk.uib.no/nfypo/osland_cv.html|title=Curriculum vitae|access-date=2022-01-06|archive-date=2022-10-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221006033203/https://folk.uib.no/nfypo/osland_cv.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
